Game Overview

Island Farm Cat Gardener is a farming game built around become a feline farmer on a mystical island, cultivating crops and unlocking new plants. Speed up growth with frequent watering, and use the magical well to boost your resources. Sell your harvest to expand your farm, enjoying charming pixel art and the challenge of creating a thriving paradise.

How to Play

Island Farm Cat Gardener keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Become a feline farmer on a mystical island, cultivating crops and unlocking new plants. Speed up growth with frequent watering, and use the magical well to boost your resources. Sell your harvest to expand your farm, enjoying charming pixel art and the challenge of creating a thriving paradise.
